top_choice_rationale: P001 honors a mature, independently confirmed discovery chain with three separable steps and clear names within the cap: Holst on human GLP-1 physiology, Mojsov on the active truncated peptide, and Drucker on GLP-1/GLP-2 biology and receptor action. Randomized outcome trials in diabetes, obesity and cardiovascular and renal disease show stable benefit. The citation is confined to physiology and the active form, so the exclusion of Knudsen rests on the cap and the discovery framing. Attribution doubts (Habener, Mojsov priority) are real but do not outweigh the case, and no award is clearly worse than honoring this discovery.
